name: Systems Auditor Examination
name_ja: システム監査技術者試験 (AU)

logistics.format: National statutory paper exam, once yearly (Spring)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded seven-year profile, senior IPA audit standing and regulator recognition support expert assurance responsibility in Japan; audit assessment does not imply hands-on incident or offensive capability.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded senior audit scope, regulator recognition and seven-year profile support expert audit judgment. Its Japanese recognition and non-practical format limit US MSSP familiarity and technical execution evidence without changing the senior scope.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded seven-year profile and senior statutory audit scope support substantial professional assurance knowledge. I stop below expert because the record explicitly lacks hands-on assessment and its recognized authority is primarily domestic.
